scientific_integrity: Graph-theoretic proof checked against exhaustive labeled-subset enumeration on small cacti and deterministic generated examples; independent external scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Cactus graphs only; inclusion-minimal connected dominating sets only; single-replacement exchange edges. Computational checks cover a finite test suite and do not replace the general proof. Equivalence in unindexed literature remains a possible originality risk.
title: A cactus block-product theorem for minimal connected domination exchanges
